title: When Begin's reserved share is already spent before the named-root guard, report a distinct unsent-Begin cause
outcome: If the Begin-guard deadline has already passed before the named-root guard runs (evaluate and the prepared-Begin fence spent more than budget minus Begin's share), the admission fails with a distinct unsent-Begin cause naming Begin's reserved share, not a persist-writer Deadline diagnostic, and a scripted-clock test that spends the budget during evaluate shows that cause with Begin unsent.
acceptance: When Begin's reserved share is already spent before the named-root guard, report a distinct unsent-Begin cause is done
